svg.text: AU Bank Insurance Distribution Platform — R0 Low-Level Design
AWS deployment as designed for S09 · ap-south-1 · one VPC per environment · the picture the CTO and AWS platform team provision from
Rendering of docs/architecture/R0-LLD.md · owns nothing (HA-02) · Istio, per-service RDS, the analytics warehouse and extra reverse proxies are drawn grey on purpose

Same services as the R0 HLD, now placed on AWS. Colour here is TRUST ZONE / SUBNET, not build wave. Solid = PROVISION in R0. Dashed grey = DO NOT PROVISION. Revised 2026-08-25 for ADR-015 (one NIP-APP; ns:edge is nip-web + #2 NIP BFF only).
The only public reverse proxy is API Gateway behind CloudFront+WAF. Internal ALB is the only in-VPC reverse proxy. Business pods have no PVC. Customer payment never enters this VPC (C4).
web + APK + IPA · roles: RM · IPR · admin/ops
EKS nip-web · Play Store · App Store · no OAuth on device
PUBLIC AWS EDGE — THE ONLY INTERNET ENTRY (not in the VPC)
no latency-based DR routing in R0
north-south only — private integration / VPC link into the INTERNAL ALB
VPC · one per environment · 10.{env}.0.0/16 · ap-south-1 · 3 AZs
prod does not share a VPC with uat
INSPECTION / EGRESS VPC (network account, one per environment) · workload public subnets stay reserved and EMPTY
No application workloads. No public ALB onto EKS. No public RDS.
TGW to Network Firewall to NAT + Elastic IP
1SB and PG allowlist THIS EIP · prod: per AZ
in the inspection VPC only — ADR-010
A public NLB/ALB onto a service is a standing-constraint violation
PRIVATE-APP SUBNETS /20 × 3 AZs · EKS nodes + Internal ALB
EKS API private in prod · NetworkPolicy default-deny · IRSA · min 2 pods, ≥2 AZs, PDB
Internal ALB = IN-VPC REVERSE PROXY (AWS Load Balancer Controller · one ALB, host/path rules, not an ALB per service)
Public ALB is not used for services. TLS re-terminated. No authN/authZ. Targets ns:edge only.
Amazon EKS · one cluster per environment · stateless pods · NO PersistentVolumeClaim on business services
Namespaces follow HLD boundaries, not 1:1 with services. Sale-path on-demand nodes. Spot is not enabled on the sale path in R0.
NIP-APP Flutter web · image-baked · NO PVC
/api/* · tokens · session · admin/MIS routes · PDP S-02
Flutter never sees OAuth (S-01) · C-ISO-1 on Lead writer
JDBC → Aurora schema keycloak · NO PVC
LOB-OWNED EXECUTION — first physical split seam (ADR-008). Health gets its OWN #10/#11 later, never if (lob==…)
async-poll via Hub S-09/S-11 · refuses without suitability id
no auto-retry on submit · poll to recover S-12
egress via the inspection VPC EIP
outbox → MSK · #18 isolated read · NEVER the Lead writer
S-15 settlement file · S-16 confirmation · never auto-resolves money
PRIVATE-DATA SUBNETS /24 × 3 AZs · no 0.0.0.0/0 route · Aurora cannot initiate internet
app + firewall + flow + broker logs · 30d hot, 90d gone · NEVER evidence — ADR-013
VPC ENDPOINTS (private) · S3 · DynamoDB · Secrets Manager · ECR · STS · CloudWatch Logs — stop secrets and images pulling via NAT
Egress, ALL of it inspected: 1SB (mTLS, not decrypted) · AU Bank PG session · CBS and Bank AD over the TGW · SMS/email gateway
IRSA on every deployable · Secrets Manager → Secrets Store CSI → tmpfs · readOnlyRootFilesystem · non-root · no privileged · Kyverno/Gatekeeper from shared-services
AWS MANAGED — REGIONAL (reached via endpoints, not a subnet)
EXTERNAL — BANK SYSTEMS vs INSURANCE PROVIDERS (two boundaries)
connectivity pattern is Shivanshi + bank network
WS-2 Phase 2 · do not block R0
over the TGW: VPN now, DX next
C4 PAYMENT PATH (drawn here because it is the hop people get wrong)

Customer device → AU Bank PG hosted page (3-D Secure). PG callback → separate API Gateway route, IP-allowlisted. RM session never receives a payment URL (FF-14). Reconciliation, not DB restore, recovers money state.
Business services: none. State is Aurora / DynamoDB / S3.
WS-3 services, #2 NIP BFF, nip-web, Hub, workers
A PVC on Keycloak would be an unreplicated identity SoR.
CACHING, MESSAGING AND SEARCH · WHAT R0 NEEDS
L1 in-process to L2 Valkey · still fails closed
owning service store — NOT the cache
CloudFront → ns:edge UI pods; no auth JSON cache
IN R0 — and each with a NEVER list
In the target-state review. Out of this slice.
▸ MSK Replicator to the DR region
DR replays from the outbox — D14
must be atomic with the write
▸ Public ALB / public RDS / public EKS
C4 payment — skips the platform edge
DR: warm standby ap-south-2 · RTO ≤ 1h measured · S3 WORM RPO 0 · money recovered by reconciliation, not restore

AI-DRAFTED in the Architecture lane (Mahesh — Board 1); mandatory human T4 Architecture sign-off outstanding · Security (Deepali), Database (Aarti) and SRE (Shivanshi) reviews outstanding before S09 apply.

Derived from R0-LLD.md, 03-solution-architecture-r0.md §4–§5, ADR-001, ADR-008, 04-security-architecture.md TB-1…TB-6. Same #n names as r0-reference-architecture.svg (NC-1). Colour is trust-zone, not build-wave.

Do not raise a landing-zone request from architecture-review/04 alone — that file is target state (Istio, per-service clusters, the warehouse). This rendering is the R0 cut. · SUG-20260820-ls1, revised SUG-20260824-gp1..gp5, SUG-20260825-ll1 · 2026-08-25
